64.content:
## Get started

Dynatrace is reporting DPS usage with BILLING_USAGE_EVENT. They are stored for 372 days (check respective bucket)

1. Adjust the `ratecard_data` variable in this dashboard, based on the rate cards of your DPS. You can check the rate cards of your DPS under `Account Management > Subscription > Pricing`. If you don't change them, the cost reflected could be higher from what your organization actually is billed. 
2. Adjust the `budget` variable in this dashboard, based on the total DPS budget commited. You can check the total budget under `Account Management > Overview`

If you're planning to use this dashboard in your tenant, make sure to make it private and share it with the right individuals, since sensitive information such as budget & rate cards will be visible

74.content:
We need to ensure all events have dt.cost.costcenter & dt.cost.product 
There are 2 types of unallocated states:
- not-allowlisted: the cost center hasn't been configured under Account Management
- unassigned: dt.cost.costcenter & dt.cost.product hasn't been set for the signal

Your goal is to reach 100% of allocation

75.query:
fetch dt.system.events
| lookup [ data json:$ratecard_data ], sourceField:event.type, lookupField:name, prefix:"ratecard."
| filter event.kind == "BILLING_USAGE_EVENT"
| dedup event.id
| fieldsAdd usage = coalesce(
    billed_host_hours,
    billed_gibibyte_hours,
    billed_bytes / (1024*1024*1024),
    billed_invocations,
    ingested_bytes / (1024*1024*1024),
    1
  )
| fieldsAdd cost = usage * toDouble(ratecard.price)
| summarize daily_cost = sum(cost), by:{day = bin(timestamp, 1d)}
| sort day asc
| makeTimeseries
    daily_cost_ts = sum(daily_cost, default: 0),
    budget_usd_ts = max(toDouble($budget), default: toDouble($budget)),
    time: day,
    interval: 1d
| fieldsAdd cumulative_cost = arrayCumulativeSum(daily_cost_ts)
| fieldsAdd cumulative_budget = arrayCumulativeSum(budget_usd_ts)

79.query:
fetch dt.system.events
| lookup [ data json:$ratecard_data ], sourceField:event.type, lookupField:name, prefix:"ratecard."
| filter event.kind == "BILLING_USAGE_EVENT"

| expand costcenter = dt.cost.costcenter
| fieldsFlatten costcenter

| fieldsAdd usage = coalesce(
    billed_host_hours,
    billed_gibibyte_hours,
    billed_bytes / (1024*1024*1024),
    billed_invocations,
    ingested_bytes / (1024*1024*1024),
    1
  )
| fieldsAdd cost = usage * toDouble(ratecard.price)
| fieldsAdd cost_center = coalesce(costcenter.key, dt.cost.costcenter, "unassigned")
| fieldsAdd entity_associated = coalesce(
    dt.entity.host,
    dt.entity.kubernetes_cluster,
    dt.entity.application,
    "none"
  )

// ✅ only show “unassigned” or “not-allowlisted”
| filter cost_center != "unassigned" AND cost_center != "not-allowlisted"

| makeTimeseries total_cost = sum(cost),
    by: { ratecard.name, cost_center, entity_associated },
    interval: 15m
79.title: ✅ costcenter 15min resolution ASSIGNED
